rows.estimand: Does the fixed encoder beat lexical retrieval of stated Motivations when distractors preferentially come from other proposal categories?
rows.public_wording: With the registered other-category preference and its required fallback, the encoder still retrieves stated Motivations less accurately than the lexical comparator; the proposed encoder advantage is rejected on this task.
rows.pursuit: Carry the complete parent and GO1.d branch into the final curator packet. Retain the declared descriptive grid for separate cost/source admission and the language-model secondary on the saved original roster when R1 provides its verified reader. No recursive GO1.d rerun or outcome-driven repair is admitted.
rows.scope: Registered other-category-priority stated-Motivation retrieval with same-stratum fallback

scope_qualifiers.analysis: Predeclared conditional contrast; selected fixed roster; not independent replication
scope_qualifiers.substrate: Human-authored public documents; model and exact-program readers

rows.strongest_rival: Shared vocabulary/topic, fallback, source selection and possible pretraining exposure; stated target is not governing purpose
rows.warrant: Committed design, complete two-bank support, native fixtures, full replay and exact 2000-draw arithmetic
